subject: Marine Works - Lake Erie - Leamington
text:
Marine Works - Lake Erie - Leamington
Dredging operations taking place 24 hours per day, 7 days a week at Leamington Marina beginning 26 Aug 2026. Dredge, barges and work boats on site. 
Unloading sites at 41 58.918N 082 33.068W and 42 00.101N 082 34.107W. 
Floating steel structure on site, 15 metres by 15 metres, with turbidity curtains at 42 01.399N 082 36.037W. Structure marked by flashing orange lights and two orange buoys with reflective tape.
